titleEn: Maximum Fruits Harvested After at Most K Steps
title: 摘水果
summary: 水果位于数轴不同位置，从 startPos 出发最多走 k 步，可摘经过位置全部水果，求最大数量。
insight: 最优访问集合是一个连续位置区间。用滑动窗口枚举左右水果端点，计算覆盖区间的最少步数：单侧为最远距离，跨起点时取先走短侧往返或先走长侧往返两方案最小。
pitfalls: 可先左后右或先右后左

solutions.title: 可达区间滑动窗口
solutions.idea: 维护步数不超过 k 的最大水果连续窗口。
steps: cost(leftPos,rightPos)：同侧取距离，跨起点取 min(2L+R,L+2R)
cost>k 时移除 left 水果并左移；更新最大和

code.java: class Solution { private int cost(int left,int right,int start){if(right<=start)return start-left;if(left>=start)return right-start;int a=start-left,b=right-start;return Math.min(2*a+b,a+2*b);}public int maxTotalFruits(int[][] fruits,int startPos,int k){int left=0,sum=0,answer=0;for(int right=0;right<fruits.length;right++){sum+=fruits[right][1];while(left<=right&&cost(fruits[left][0],fruits[right][0],startPos)>k)sum-=fruits[left++][1];answer=Math.max(answer,sum);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun cost(left:Int,right:Int,start:Int):Int{if(right<=start)return start-left;if(left>=start)return right-start;val a=start-left;val b=right-start;return minOf(2*a+b,a+2*b)};fun maxTotalFruits(fruits:Array<IntArray>,startPos:Int,k:Int):Int{var left=0;var sum=0;var answer=0;for(right in fruits.indices){sum+=fruits[right][1];while(left<=right&&cost(fruits[left][0],fruits[right][0],startPos)>k)sum-=fruits[left++][1];answer=maxOf(answer,sum)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int cost(int left,int right,int start){if(right<=start)return start-left;if(left>=start)return right-start;int a=start-left,b=right-start;return min(2*a+b,a+2*b);}public: int maxTotalFruits(vector<vector<int>>& fruits,int startPos,int k){int left=0,sum=0,answer=0;for(int right=0;right<(int)fruits.size();++right){sum+=fruits[right][1];while(left<=right&&cost(fruits[left][0],fruits[right][0],startPos)>k)sum-=fruits[left++][1];answer=max(answer,sum);}return answer;} };
